# 🌟 ALPINE PEAK VOICE CHATBOT WORKFLOW - FIXED RAG

## Overview
Complete RAG-powered chatbot with FIXED embedding integration

## KEY FIX APPLIED
✅ **Embeddings OpenAI node now properly connected**
✅ **Text flows through embeddings BEFORE vector search**
✅ **Using latest n8n v1.112.0 compatible nodes**

## Key Features
✅ **Dual Input**: Text + Voice webhooks
✅ **RAG Knowledge Base**: Supabase vector store with embeddings
✅ **Voice Processing**: Whisper STT + Nova TTS
✅ **CRM Integration**: Lead capture + conversation logging
✅ **Email Follow-up**: Automated knowledge sharing
✅ **Emergency Handling**: Priority routing

## Webhook Endpoints
**Text**: `/webhook/alpine-peak-chatbot`
**Voice**: `/webhook/alpine-peak-voice-chat`

## Credentials Required
- OpenAI API (GPT-4, Whisper, TTS, Embeddings)
- Supabase API (Vector store + CRM)
- Gmail OAuth2 (Email sending)

## Architecture Flow
1. Webhook Entry → 2. Preprocessing → 3. EMBEDDINGS → 4. RAG Search → 5. AI Response → 6. TTS (voice) → 7. CRM Logging → 8. Email Follow-up

**Fixed using n8n MCP Server validation for n8n v1.112.0**

## 📝 Text Preprocessing Code Node

**Purpose:** Processes incoming text webhook messages

**Key Functions:**
• Extracts and validates message text from webhook body
• Detects email addresses using regex pattern
• Analyzes user intent (emergency, estimation, scheduling, etc.)
• Calculates lead scoring based on content and email presence
• Sets priority levels (urgent, high, normal)
• Prepares structured data for RAG pipeline

**Connections:**
• **IN:** Text Webhook → message + session data
• **OUT:** → Embeddings OpenAI (text vectorization)

**Output:** Clean message data with intent analysis and lead scoring

## 🎙️ Voice Preprocessing Code Node

**Purpose:** Initial processing of voice webhook input

**Key Functions:**
• Validates incoming audio binary data
• Extracts session metadata from voice webhook
• Prepares audio data for Whisper transcription
• Sets up voice-specific data structure
• Handles missing audio with error messages

**Connections:**
• **IN:** Voice Webhook → audio binary + metadata
• **OUT:** → Whisper STT (audio transcription)

**Output:** Voice metadata + audio binary ready for transcription

## 🎤 Voice Processing Code Node

**Purpose:** Processes voice transcription and enriches voice data

**Key Functions:**
• Extracts transcribed text from Whisper STT output
• Handles unclear audio with fallback messages
• Detects email addresses in voice transcriptions
• Performs intent analysis on spoken content
• Applies voice interaction bonus to lead scoring
• Merges voice metadata with transcription results

**Connections:**
• **IN:** Whisper STT → transcribed text + Voice Preprocessing → metadata
• **OUT:** → Embeddings OpenAI (text vectorization)

**Output:** Structured voice data ready for RAG pipeline with enhanced scoring

## 🧠 Build Context Code Node

**Purpose:** Creates comprehensive AI context from RAG search results

**Key Functions:**
• Processes vector search results from Supabase
• Extracts knowledge sources (title + content)
• Builds formatted RAG context for AI prompt
• Creates dynamic system prompt with company info
• Adds voice-specific or emergency-specific instructions
• Combines original data with knowledge context

**Connections:**
• **IN:** Knowledge Search → RAG results + Text/Voice Processing → user data
• **OUT:** → AI Response (GPT-4 chat completion)

**Output:** Complete context package for AI with RAG knowledge and system prompt

## 📤 Format Response Code Node

**Purpose:** Formats AI response for webhook delivery and downstream processing

**Key Functions:**
• Extracts AI response from multiple possible formats
• Applies markdown formatting for text responses
• Handles TTS audio URL generation for voice
• Creates context-aware call-to-action messages
• Builds comprehensive metadata including knowledge sources
• Passes user email and knowledge data to email pipeline

**Connections:**
• **IN:** AI Response → GPT response + TTS Generation → audio + Build Context → user data
• **OUT:** → Webhook Response + Should Send Email? + Log Conversation

**Output:** Complete response object with text/audio + metadata for webhooks and emails

## 📧 Prepare Email Code Node

**Purpose:** Builds personalized email content with RAG knowledge

**Key Functions:**
• Retrieves knowledge sources from Format Response metadata
• Creates HTML email template with company branding
• Includes relevant knowledge base articles in email
• Adds proper call-to-action with correct Calendly links
• Handles cases with no knowledge gracefully
• Generates dynamic subject lines based on intent

**Connections:**
• **IN:** Should Send Email? → Format Response metadata
• **OUT:** → Send Email (Gmail)

**Output:** Complete email package (content, subject, recipient) ready for Gmail sending
